cause.description: What stopped the last test, and why it happened: the abort's condition and reason, then what caused it.

evidence.description: What in the last test's record shows it: the minute, the reading, the event, the alarm.

whyNotPrevented.description: Why the last procedure did not prevent it, or stop earlier.

path.description: The field of the procedure that changes, by its path (monitoring.band.maxBpm, steps.1.minutes, abort, occupancy...).

prevents.description: How that keeps the cause from coming back, or stops the test sooner if it does.

changes.description: What the new test changes so that what stopped the last one does not happen again: each change a field of the procedure, which the new procedure must indeed change.
